_doc: Studio tuning knobs. Values live in edit.knobs and are applied non-destructively at bake time (scripts/vedit/knobs.py, mirrored live in studio/js/bake.js), so the Studio preview, the render and every hand-off agree. Unset = the edit as Claude wrote it.

pace.label: Pace
pace.help: Removes pauses inside kept takes. 0 keeps natural breaths (pauses up to 1.2 s); 1 is tight jump cuts (pauses over 0.18 s cut).

transitions.label: Transitions
transitions.help: keep = Claude's choices; others apply one style to every cut.

zoom_strength.label: Zoom strength
zoom_strength.help: Scales every punch-in / Ken Burns move. 0 = static.

caption_y.label: Caption height
caption_y.help: Half-canvas units from the centre; -0.42 is the lower third of a 9:16 frame.

graphics_on.label: Graphics
graphics_on.help: Hide every overlay to judge the bare cut.
